text: I had a filling done here. The dentist said it would last almost a year, but it's been a year and a half now and the filled tooth is showing no symptoms at all. The dentist was very gentle; it didn't hurt at all. Because I never had any dental problems as a child, I never had a filling until now, at age 29. It was my first time, and I'm very impressed.

I initially planned to take my mother to the dentist for a dental consultation, but as soon as she went in, they pulled out a tooth without even checking her blood pressure. Now, two days later, there's still blood coming from the extraction site. However, the service was good.
